Back home, Samantha uses magic to duplicate an Aubert original. Doris, J.T,'s wife admires the dress. Suddenly. Samantha finds herself committed to making dresses for Doris, J.T.'s sister, Ethel, and Gladys Kravitz. Darrin reveals J.T.'s party is a preview of original creations by his new client, Aubert. Samantha is stunning but the other three women look awful in their creations. Aubert faints when he sees the women wearing his "originals." Later Darrin tells Samantha that Aubert, certain he has been doublecrossed, is suing the agency. Samantha convinces Aubert that he has failed in the American market because he hasn't created dresses for women like Doris and Gladys. With Aubert designing, Samantha finishes dresses for another show in which even Gladys is a standout.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Darrin reacts violently when he finds Brian O'Brian, a sprightly leprechaun, a guest in his home. Samantha tells him that Brian is not her relative but the leprechaun of Darrin's family. Brian reveals he has come to recover his pot of gold which was hidden in a fireplace brought to America by James Dennis Robinson. Darrin finds that Robinson owns a company whose account would be a great asset to Darrin's agency. Brian breaks into Robinson's house to retrieve the gold and is arrested. Darrin allows Samantha to use her magic to get Brian out of jail. Brian pleads with Samantha to help him recover his pot of gold which will restore his lost powers. Pledging Brian never to tell Darrin, Samantha returns with him to the Robinson's house. Robinson finds them in his study and reveals he has already removed the pot from the fireplace. Samantha is sur-prised when Robinson tells her he believes the leprechaun's story because his grandfather was a Mahoney, and returns Brian's pot of gold. Brian agrees to allow Robinson to use his picture as a trade mark if Robinson turns his advertising over to Darrin.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Finding Samantha struggling to repair a lamp, Aunt Clara uses her uncertain powers of magic to summon an electrician. Benjamin Franklin, in l8th century clothes, appears. Samantha is upset by Ben's presence and Aunt Clara's wail that she can't remember how to undo the spell. Darrin, astonished by Ben's appearance in his home, can't convince Larry Tate that Ben is not is creation for an advertising campaign for Franklin Elec-tronics. Abner Kravitz refuses to believe Gladys' report that the real Ben Franklin is at the Stephens'. Bowing to Samantha's pleas, Darrin agrees to allow her and Aunt Clara to show Ben how his inventions are being used is the city. The next morning Ben, leaving a note that he has decided to tour the city alone to avoid causing domestic discord, sets out. Darrin, Samantha and Aunt Clara start searching for him. At a firehouse, inspecting an old fire engine, Ben steps on the accelerator. The engine shoots out into the street and slams into a curb. Ben is arrested and taken to court, where the judge, sure it is all a publicity stunt, charges him with grand larceny and sets bail at a thousand dollars. Darrin puts up the bail, knowing he will lose it if Ben doesn't appear for trial is a month. Just then, Aunt Clara remembers the spell and Ben vanishes.

programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.sub-title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: Interesting Sculptures of Daeungjeon Hall of Jeondeungsa Temple
programme.desc: There is an interesting legend about the unique statues of a naked woman that prop up the eaves of Daeungjeon Hall of Jeondeungsa Temple on Ganghwado Island. It is said that a carpenter who participated in the construction of the hall fell in love with a woman and that he made these statues to punish her or to cleanse her soul of sin after she betrayed his love.

programme.desc: On a hill behind Hwaeomsa Temple in Jirisan Mountain stands the Three-Story Four-Lion Stone Pagoda(National Treasure No.35). The four lions of the pagoda look very impressive while the gorgeous shapes of the celestial maids inscribed on the pedestal and the main body of the pagoda display the artistic skills of Unified Silla.

programme.title: The Scenery of Korean Temples: The Mahavira Hall of Gaeamsa Temple

programme.title: The Nature of All Things

programme.title: Astrology Zone
programme.desc: Susan Miller is the founder and astrologist for AstrologyZone.com. The trusted, twenty-year-old platform provides the latest in intelligent astrological trends. This discussion with Deepak Chopra breaks down many popular misconceptions about astrological predictions, the various disciplines of study, ego, and consciousness in relation to astrology. Miller also outlines the golden rule to understanding and getting the most out of astrological predications: astrology shows the condition, but not the outcomethat outcome is completely up to you. I can give you questions to ask to help you decide, but in the end, you write the script of your life.

programme.title: Modern Metaphysical Idealism
programme.desc: Dr. Bernardo Kastrup, philosopher and author has been leading the modern renaissance of metaphysical idealism. His theoretical reflections on the mind explain consciousness as the only element of life that allows us to understand reality, and everything we know about reality is subject to our experiences. This idea is often refuted by the thought that the brain is the source, not images and experiences provided by consciousness.

programme.title: Book Of Knowledge
programme.desc: Traveling the world 30+ years, David Verdesi finds himself back in Rome. Urged to uncover the reason behind the instinctive human desire for spiritual yearning, Verdesi starts retracing the intersection of science and theology within the city his family has called home since the early 1400s. Vibrating from the walls of the citys sacred spaces, he discovers findings of oral history, predating the beginning of humanity by thousands of years. Documents and rare rituals that upend conventional ideas of the behaviors of the mind in ancient times. Narratives heavily influenced by civilizations and cultures beyond Rome, continue to influence the moral compass of life today, Verdesi realizes he is back on the road. Book of Knowledge The Quest for Meaning rediscovers and preserves the knowledge of our human potential and natures wisdom. This movie addresses questions around the intersection of science, spirituality, and anthropology. Join David Verdesi to the roots of the Book of Knowledge.

programme.title: Across the Ice
programme.desc: After 45+ expeditions throughout over 150+ countries, one of the world's leading adventurers and visionaries of conservation, Swedish explorer Johan Ernst Nilson dawns upon his biggest adventure yet. Follow his journey across the planet from the North Pole to the South Pole in Pole2Pole. The 525 day mostly carbon-neutral trek covers 20,000 miles by means of skis, dogsled, boat, bike and kite. Pole2Pole is not only one of the most difficult adventures hes ever attempted, but also one of his most philanthropic adventures. Johan visits charities along the way to share their stories and raise global awareness.

programme.title: Chasing Bliss
programme.desc: Water is life, and the great conductor that connects us all. The oceans cover over 70% of our planet and hold almost 97% of the earth's water. True bliss in constant movement giving life around the globe. This is a story of an eclectic mix of people across Hawaii, Ecuador and the USA, who draw energy from this life force and channel it positively into their everyday lives. programme.title: Particle Physics
programme.desc: At only 21, Frank Wilczek, a graduate student at Princeton University, defined the properties of color gluons, which hold atomic nuclei together while working with David Gross. He is known, among other things, for the discovery of asymptotic freedom, the development of quantum chromodynamics, the invention of axions, and the discovery and exploitation of new forms of quantum statistics (anyons).

Our interpretations continue to change and more theories form as we learn and study these topics. Dr. Fred Alan Wolf explains the origins of many of these foundational theories that have formed at different times and why they came about. Before quantum physics, people knew that human beings were conscious. We knew that animals were conscious. But now, with new revelations in quantum physics we begin to see a new role for consciousness.

programme.title: Creation Is Constant
programme.desc: Duane Elgin wants to show that the universe is a living field of existence, and that we are always in communion with a field of aliveness whether we are conscious of it or not. Throughout this lecture, Elgin explains his belief that in a living system, each part is integral to the whole, so each entity is intimately connected to the entire universe. To him, creation is not something that happened with the Big Bang. Instead, creation is consistently forming around us from a deeper abyss. The universes existence is brought moment by moment through this continuous, moving process.

programme.title: The Sobras Institute

The Sobras Institute is a private research and teaching institute offering experiential workshops and private coaching for developing practical self-support skills for sustainable mental, emotional and physical well-being. She discusses her research and lifes work at length in this discussion with Deepak Chopra.

programme.title: Mind-Body Healing

He started taking it seriously for himself and the shift also reflected in his career. Dr. Gordon created ground-breaking programs of comprehensive mind-body healing for physicians, medical students, and other health professionals, and people with cancer, depression and other chronic illnesses. Mind-body medicine is based on the scientific understanding of the inextricable connection between our inner selves and the social and natural world in which we live.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Embark on an immersive journey through the heart of the Indo-Pacific as we explore the breathtaking coral reef ecosystem, home to an array of vibrant fish species and magnificent manta rays. Let's unearth the secrets of a prehistoric cave nestled within this underwater wonderland and marvel at the stunning beauty of the shoals of fish that dance around us. The vibrant colors and intricate details of this marine paradise offer a mesmerizing glimpse into the world beneath the waves that captivate with the majesty and wonder of the coral reef, as we witness nature at its most spectacular.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: A mesmerizing journey on the border of two amazing worlds - beyond the turquoise waters of Raja Ampat, a paradise of diverse coral gardens, multitudes of fascinating species of fish and towering barrel sponges and up on the land where the unique cultures and ways of life, as well as struggles and triumphs of the people who call this remote and stunning corner of the world home are shown.

programme.title: If There Was No Land On Earth
programme.desc: Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Wayag archipelago and its underwater wonders. From vibrant coral gardens to a diverse array of marine creatures, immerse yourself in the mesmerizing world beneath the surface. Discover how the beautiful pearls are made and meet the dedicated people behind the process. Witness the silky shark's grace and agility in its underwater habitat and learn about the bamboo shark's unique characteristics and behaviors.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The East Auckland current warms the waters around the world-renowned Poor Knights Islands, creating an astonishing environment. Caves and arches hold the only known congregation of stingrays which stack themselves between underwater walls. Demoiselles and Black Angelfish fathers protect their eggs with determination, and must keep a watchful eye on neighbors who will raid their nests in an instant! When disaster strikes and the male Sandagers Wrasse disappears, one of the harem of females undergoes a sex change to pick up the missing male's responsibilities. On land, the Tuatara and Giant Weta fuel an ancient feud, while Gannets rest for their next attack.

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: Hannah Emde meets one of Africa's most experienced elephant trackers: Hendrick Munembome, the Director of Elephant Human Relations Aid (EHRA).

programme.title: Hannah Goes to Namibia
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions

programme.title: Wild and Alive
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal.

programme.desc: This week on Americana Outdoors, we look at all the ways that you can hunt hogs and then we'll go on a whitetail adventure with Brian Flaherty of TenPoint Crossbows where he's going to encounter his best buck ever.

programme.title: Late Season Horseback Bulls - Part 1
programme.desc: Join Mitch and Lynn as they head out by horseback on a high country elk hunt after some late season bulls for their 2nd wedding anniversary. The air is thin and cold but the action is hot and heavy. The horses are saddled and the excitement is high as the romantic couple find bulls on almost every ridge top

programme.title: The Stone Oven
programme.desc: In British Columbia, there is a legend of an ancient stone oven that was built in the mountains during construction of the railroad. Josh sets out on a trip to reconnect with his brothers, do some fishing, explore and ultimately search for this 100-year-old oven if he has come all this way, a meal is in order

programme.title: Creative
programme.desc: Michael moves to Iowa and it is his first fall hunting Iowa as a resident. After scouting public ground all summer and early fall, things come together for him in November on an awesome hunt over a decoy

programme.title: Return To Whitetail - Part 2
programme.desc: Blake Barnett continues his hunt for old whitetail deer on the Lowrance Ranch of North Texas

programme.title: Return To Whitetail - Part 1
programme.desc: After previously guiding a successful hunt earlier in the year in the area, Blake Barnett returns to the Lowrance in the Texas panhandle to hunt whitetail deer

programme.title: World Snowmobile HQ & CKX Gear
programme.desc: STV reads a book this week, checks out some gear from CKX and Jeff takes out the crap cans for a ride to see how their running!

programme.title: Commotion
programme.desc: Brennen heads to Kansas after a couple of years of not drawing a tag. After a bunch of scouting on public land and a few non productive sits, it all comes together during a classic rut hunt over a decoy in late November

programme.title: Beauchene Bass Bash
programme.desc: Taylor and Brittany target smallmouth bass in Northwestern Quebec, while exploring the waters of Beauchene Wilderness Lodge

programme.title: Andy Bean in Southwest Florida
programme.desc: Andy Bean in Southwest Florida

programme.title: Tradition
programme.desc: Josh heads to Camp Dinkota in North Dakota to kick off the late season push and arrows an awesome whitetail. Then Dylan joins Josh in deer camp and only a day later after Josh kills a good buck, Dylan has an opportunity at another great whitetail

programme.title: Top Celebrity Fish Catches!
programme.desc: Over his 34 years on TV, Henry Waszczuk has had more than 100 celebrity guests on camera & theyve landed some pretty nice fish. This special will keep you at the edge of your seat with some great catches, featuring Henrys top celebrity guests

programme.title: Fall on Stump Lake
programme.desc: Don Freschi and Brian Chan fly fish Stump Lake in the fall using a variety of fly patterns; mainly Baby Damsels, Blobs and Leeches.

programme.title: Team200 Canada
programme.desc: Clay Charlton , owner of Take-Em Outfitters, is the newest member of Team200 and shares his 2021 season as he chases giant whitetails in Alberta and Saskatchewan

programme.title: Cree River Monsters
programme.desc: Team200 visits the Cree River Lodge in Northern Saskatchewan to hunt giant black bear. Spot & stalk archery action plus monster northern pike!

programme.title: Late Season Horseback Bulls - Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing with their anniversary hunt, Mitch and Lynn are in the high country on an elk hunt in search of late season horseback bulls. With some hunting pressure in the area from other hunters, they move to a new location and find multiple bulls in a high country saddle. With lots of daylight left they wait them out and put a great bull on the ground!

programme.title: Sooner" Or Later"
programme.desc: We're headed out to Oklahoma to follow along with the Sharp brothers as they hunt whitetails in their home state. You never know what to expect with these two but one thing you can always rely on is that they always have some big deer to go after!

programme.title: Redfish, Snook & Pompano Too!
programme.desc: Pompano are known as one of the finest tasting saltwater fish. They are feisty and fight hard for their size. Henry Waszczuk heads to the quaint fishing village of Cortez to tangle with these tasty fish

programme.title: Redfish, Snook & Pompano Too!
programme.desc: Pompano are known as one of the finest tasting saltwater fish. They are feisty and fight hard for their size. Henry Waszczuk heads to the quaint fishing village of Cortez to tangle with these tasty fish

programme.title: A Decade of Dominance with Steve Ecklund
programme.desc: Celebrate a decade of wilderness exploration with Steve Ecklund, as he marks ten thrilling years of capturing his hunting adventures on film. From rugged landscapes to awe-inspiring encounters, join him in reliving the exhilarating journey of a true outdoorsman

programme.title: Iowa Gun Season
programme.desc: Iowa is a magical place where whitetail hunters' dreams can come true. In this episode, Jerry finds himself back in this coveted state chasing some monster bucks with Cole

programme.title: NHL Best Canada
programme.desc: NHL Best Canada

programme.title: Fly Fishing the Weed Beds
programme.desc: Don and Dale Freschi experience extremely windy conditions that forces them into the weeds for some crazy fishing

programme.title: The Maybe Buck
programme.desc: Taylor Partridge's Excalibur crossbow hunt for a MONSTER typical whitetail. A summer's work leads to a decision on whether or not to hunt a deer that turns out to be one of the largest in Canadian Whitetail history.

programme.title: The OGs vs Newbees Hunting Competition: Week 12
programme.desc: A hunting competition featuring the Whitetail Frenzy originals aka The OGs vs a group of new staff members aka The Newbees.

programme.title: A Look Back
programme.desc: The guys look back on an unbelievable year of fishing. From offshore giants to bays, this was one action packed season.

programme.title: Pike & Smallmouth Bass
programme.desc: Casting lures for weed & structure pike and smallmouth bass.

programme.title: Hunting for a Giant
programme.desc: Our first hunt takes us along with our recipient Jacob whose dream of taking down a giant bull moose is about to become a reality. Then we join Brody, who is new to hunting but has the big dream of taking a big ol' trophy whitetail buck!

programme.title: Fun
programme.desc: This week Marc, Amber and Lorne are out hitting some trails looking for grouse.

programme.title: Modern Heroes - Part 2
programme.desc: Part two of our Modern Heroes special, features the Rhinelander, Wisconsin volunteer fire department as they answer a call to save a fallen hunter.

programme.title: Fourteen
programme.desc: After a horrible hunt in the Hill Country, Blaine spends his last day in South Texas looking for a unicorn 14-point buck.

programme.desc: A hunting competition featuring the Whitetail Frenzy originals aka The OGs vs a group of new staff members aka The Newbees.

programme.title: One Shot Moose Kill
programme.desc: We start off with Keegan whose dream is to take a crack at one the largest animals in North America, then O.A.F. star Gabe is back for his first turkey hunt, lastly returning hunter Jamison is on a spot & stalk North Dakota elk hunt of epic portions.

programme.title: Colorado Dream Hunt
programme.desc: A culmination of volunteers and donors come together to give our recipient the absolute hunt of a lifetime! First, we join Dustin on an intense spot n stalk hunt for an elk followed by a good old-fashioned prairie dog shoot.

programme.title: Measure in Memories
programme.desc: Editor-in-Chief Dan Schmidt returns to his roots of shooting, what makes him happy, and explains why you should have no apologies for doing the exact same thing.

programme.title: These Colours Run Deep
programme.desc: This week Marc and Bill head out to meet up with some of the guys to go after some geese.

programme.title: Mesquite
programme.desc: Texas is known for being target rich, and the boys have proven that. They shot so many bucks in October it barely fits into an episode!

programme.title: Bed Bucks
programme.desc: The DDH team shares best practices for identifying and hunting whitetail bedding areas.

programme.title: Living
programme.desc: Join the Holder family as they take a look at an entire hunting season and how hunting mimics life.

programme.title: Back to Back Bruins
programme.desc: Mitchell targets a beautiful black bear in the boreal forests of Alberta.

programme.title: Up to Us
programme.desc: Follow along as David takes us through an Iowa archery season, explaining why hunters do what they do.

programme.title: The Long Game - Part 3
programme.desc: The conclusion to Rochelle's unbelievable years long hunt, and the massive reward that can come when rolling the dice.

programme.title: Timing is Everything
programme.desc: Join Kristy Titus for this episode of Pursue the Wild where she hunts whitetail in Missouri and Kansas.

programme.title: Trolling Walleye & Lake Trout
programme.desc: Great Lakes open-water walleye and lake trout.

programme.desc: For the maiden voyage of the new Kingfisher Boats 3025 GFX Brendan wanted to bring on a very special guest. An expert of the ocean and everyone’s favourite 6 ton mammal, Fin the whale, official mascot of the Vancouver Canucks.

programme.title: Early Season Waterfowl in Saskatchewan
programme.desc: Chris Dorsey returns to the top of the flyway for his own annual migration as he hunts early season waterfowl in Saskatchewan with good friend Steve Hicks.

programme.desc: Kristy Titus takes you behind the scenes on a more personal level, showcasing some of her favorite North American big game hunts for moose, mountain goat, Dall sheep and mountain caribou.

programme.title: Modern Heroes - Part 1
programme.desc: Treestand accidents unfortunately happen every year despite efforts of public awareness. On this episode of Modern Hunter we showcase a mock hunting accident and the modern heroes that are standing by to answer the call.

programme.desc: It’s bear season in Alaska, and Mike has been waiting four years to get this permit. He’s got an itch to take down a big bear, and the Savage is sighted in.

programme.title: Dreams Become Reality
